visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a white, vintage-style telephone-like electronic device. A small rectangular screen embedded in its base displays a video of a man and a woman speaking; the woman has long dark hair and the man has short dark hair. The device sits on a beige, textured, woven fabric surface under bright, even lighting. (2) The view transitions to a medium-full shot of the couple. The woman wears a white sleeveless top and a pearl necklace, smiling broadly. The man, in a pink t-shirt, holds the white telephone handset to his ear while gesturing towards the camera. They are indoors with soft, warm lighting and a neutral background. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor garden wedding. A groom in a white tuxedo and a bride in a voluminous white wedding gown stand facing each other on a gravel path. A large group of guests, all dressed in white, is gathered in the background under lush green trees. The lighting is bright, natural daylight. (4) A series of quick cuts follows, featuring various wedding guests. Each guest is shown in a split-screen or inset view, holding the white telephone handset and speaking with animated facial expressions—some laughing, some crying, and others waving. The background of these shots is the static, wide-angle view of the wedding party in the garden. (5) The guests exhibit diverse styles, from formal white dresses to casual white shirts. Their hand movements are expressive as they grip the handset. The setting remains consistent throughout the montage, characterized by the contrast between the green foliage and the white-clad crowd.
